intro.text: A restaurant owner and notorious crime lord in T'Telir who was a strong supporter of Vahr's rebellion.

items.text: Denth hopes Grable will keep unrest going in T'Telir by attacking food caravans. Setting up a meeting at one of his restaurants takes weeks, and Denth has to pay him simply for his time.

Grable doesn't believe Vivenna is really the princess, assuming she just has enough royal blood to change her hair colour, but says she would be useful for schemes either way. It soon becomes clear he wants her for his own ends rather than to help their cause.
When Denth refuses to sell her, Grable's bodyguards go for him, and he kills them in an instant. Tonk Fah reckons Grable gained either way: he would have got Vivenna, or a measure of Denth's skill.

Unruffled by the fight, Grable says he has been wary of Denth since he showed up a decade ago, pointing to his obscure past and inhuman speed. He sends no more guards after them, and Denth leaves with Vivenna and Tonk Fah, careful not to be followed by Grable's spies.

appearance.text: He flaunts his wealth in bright colours and his power in the number of bodyguards around him, but has a long, greasy beard and missing teeth.
